charts.title: TOI-3714 b: orbits around TOI-3714
charts.description: The orbits of TOI-3714's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-3714 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Hartman et al. 2023 (2023AJ....166..163H), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname HARTMAN_ET_AL__2023): P 2.15484802 d

charts.title: TOI-3714 b: its transit
charts.description: TOI-3714 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 2 sectors (59, 86) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 155867025, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 7-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 7-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
